# NFL Daily — 2026-10-31 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Colts are open to trading RB Jonathan Taylor, with multiple teams reaching out ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50323095/sources-colts-willing-trade-star-rb-jonathan-taylor)
- Jets say there's "no way" they trade WR Garrett Wilson before the Nov. 10 deadline, despite trade buzz. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50331651/no-way-jets-trade-garrett-wilson-deadline-source-says)
- Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered a season-ending foot fracture in practice, ending any trade speculation around him. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/commanders-daron-payne-suffers-season-ending-foot-fracture/)
- NFL will review new allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs after police records revealed additional accusers beyond his May arrest. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50338005/nfl-review-additional-allegations-packers-jacobs)
- Patriots ruled out WR A.J. Brown (knee) for a fifth game this season; RB TreVeyon Henderson also out vs. the Dolphins. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7739278/2026/10/31/aj-brown-out-knee-injury-patriots/)
- Packers' Micah Parsons is targeting a Thanksgiving Eve return against the Rams. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50335391/sources-packers-micah-parsons-eye-thanksgiving-eve-return)

## Transactions
- Titans traded DT Jeffery Simmons to the Bears; Titans GM Mike Borgonzi called it an offer he "couldn't refuse." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50327830/titans-call-too-good-pass-next-trading-jeffery-simmons)

- _No qualifying injury updates in this window._

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-31 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson is back, cleared to return from a three-game absence (ankle) and start Sunday against the Bills. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-look-to-reboot-with-lamar-jackson-returning-50-words-week-8-buffalo-bills)
- Ravens activated CB T.J. Tampa Jr. off injured reserve and elevated OLB Adisa Isaac and OT Chuma Edoga from the practice squad for Sunday; RB Adam Randall was not activated. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-activate-tj-tampa-chuma-edoga-adisa-isaac-elevations-bills)
- Coach John Harbaugh pursued a trade for Titans DT Jeffery Simmons before Simmons was dealt to the Bears, per report. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/giant-john-harbaugh-called-titans-to-try-to-trade-for-jeffery-simmons/)

# Rivals — 2026-10-31 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers and Browns meet in Week 8 with first place in the AFC North on the line. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/steelers-vs-browns-where-to-watch-prediction/)
- Browns DT Mike Hall Jr. returns after missing three games, expected to give Cleveland's pass rush a boost against the Steelers. [Cabot](https://x.com/MaryKayCabot/status/2116293312852484498)
- Chiefs downgraded CB Mansoor Delane to out (shoulder) and placed CB L'Jarius Sneed on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game at Denver. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2116611711981519008) — also [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2116610480626180381)
- Chiefs visit the Broncos in a game that could decide the AFC West. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/broncos-chiefs-where-to-watch-prediction/)
